findings.description: The data bucket is marked public in the configuration (comment) and has no private ACL or restricting bucket policy, while it stores customer-master.xlsx (customer PII) via aws_s3_bucket_object.data_object. Anyone can read the customer master data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is set, so customer-master data stored in this bucket is persisted in plaintext at rest.

The customer-master.xlsx object is uploaded without server_side_encryption into an unencrypted, publicly exposed bucket, leaving customer PII in plaintext at rest and readable by unauthenticated users.
The financials bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so financial data is stored unencrypted at rest despite the private ACL.
The operations bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so operational data is persisted in plaintext at rest.
The data_science bucket has no server_side_encryption_configuration, so data is stored unencrypted at rest.
